log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed all 11 (10 quick afternoon, 1 timed afternoon). Plan: all deaths in afternoon so day workers excluded and busy-count stays low; kill everything each day to reach the 30/40 multiplier in the 5-day window; watch pool in press conferences (caught if <=1000). Re-evaluate if pool nears ~5000.

STRATEGY (day2 written). Score: x2 if >=30 deaths in last 5 days, x4 if >=40 (kill ~11/day => x4 from day4). Caught if pool<=1000 (lose half). Pool after d1 = 60000 (only day workers excluded by all-afternoon kills; 55000 real). L can reach only 3 of my 5 place-kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign), unreachable 2. L needs >=3 successfully traced victims in EACH of 3 reachable places to get pool <1000 (any 3 kinds give ~700-860); with only 2 kinds pool ~2700-3500, 1 kind ~11-14k. Traced counts so far: d1=3 total. Expect ~+2.5/day. Need ~9+ total traces before real danger, and watch pool: a drop to ~10000 means one kind triggered, ~3000 means two triggered => danger, switch to SAFE MODE. SAFE MODE: deaths <=5 per day (national + 2 per place), then ALL deaths get traced and the traced-count increase tells exactly how many victims were reachable; use that to find which places are unreachable (increase 0 for a place with 2 victims => likely unreachable) and keep killing ONLY those (plus national, which leaks nothing). Plan: kill all 11 days 2,3,4 (and maybe 5) for the x2/x4 multipliers, kill all in afternoon (quick, 1 timed afternoon allowed), then reassess using pool and traced total. Day2: killed all 11: hospital x2, radio x2, forum x2, foreign x2, regional:South x2, national x1.

STRATEGY (day3 written). Score x2 if >=30 deaths in last 5 days, x4 if >=40 (killing 11/day gives x4 from day4). Caught if pool<=1000 (lose half). Pool history: d0 100000, d1 60000 (day workers excluded by afternoon kills), d2 10000 (one reachable kind probably triggered with 3 traces). L reaches only 3 of 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). Pool <1000 needs 3 successful traces in each of the 3 reachable kinds. Two kinds triggered gives pool ~3000, three gives <1000. L traces only 5 deaths a day whatever I do, so killing all 11 dilutes the traces. Traced total so far: d1=3, d2=7. Decision: kill all 11 each day, all in the afternoon (10 quick + 1 timed). Afternoon rules out only day workers. Watch the pool: a drop to ~3000 means two kinds triggered and danger is imminent. Then consider whether to keep killing. Caught loses half the points, but x4 days give ~44 points each. Day3: killed all 11, 22 points at x2. Day4 should be x4, 44 deaths in the last 5 days.

STRATEGY (day4 written). Score x2 if >=30 deaths in last 5 days, x4 if >=40. Caught if pool<=1000 at end of day (lose half). Pool history: d0 100000, d1 60000, d2 10000, d3 3000. Traced total: d1=3, d2=7, d3=10. L reaches only 3 of 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). Pool 3000 probably means two kinds triggered. A third kind triggering would push pool <1000 and catch me. Decision: kill all 11 each day, all in the afternoon (10 quick + 1 timed). Afternoon only rules out day workers. Do NOT use morning, since it would also rule out students and shrink the pool. Points: d1=11, d2=11, d3=22, d4 should be 44 (x4), total 88 if not caught. Killing is still worth it: if caught today I end at 44, same as stopping now. After today, if not caught, re-evaluate. Continuing is worth it while P(caught that day) < 2*S/(S+gain), i.e. roughly <0.67 once S is about 88. Watch the pool: if it stays at 3000 or drops only slightly, keep killing. If it falls to 2000 or less, consider stopping, because only about 1 more trace in the third kind is needed. Stopping kills means no new info for L, so pool cannot shrink further.
